title: Stationary inert-active factorization and orthogonality in symmetric operadic families
statement: Use small quasicategories and their mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], symmetric operadic families of [def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family], and cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $S$ be a small quasicategory and let $\pi:M^\otimes\to S\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ be an $S$-family of symmetric infinity-operads. Call an edge stationary inert if it is $\pi$-cocartesian, its $S$-edge is an identity, and its pointed map is inert; call an edge active if its pointed map is active, with no restriction on its $S$-edge. Every edge $h:x\to z$ admits a factorization $x\xrightarrow{i}x_D\xrightarrow{a}z$ with $i$ stationary inert and $a$ active. If $\alpha:\langle k\rangle\to\langle l\rangle$ is the pointed map of $h$, then $D=\{u\ne *:\alpha(u)\ne *\}$, $x_D$ is the inert restriction over $D_+=D\amalg\{*\}$ in the parameter fiber of $x$, and the factorization includes a specified composition homotopy to $h$. For any stationary inert $i:x\to y$ and any active $a:u\to v$, the composition map $$\operatorname{Map}_{M^\otimes}(y,u)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{M^\otimes}(x,u)\times^h_{\operatorname{Map}_{M^\otimes}(x,v)}\operatorname{Map}_{M^\otimes}(y,v),\quad f\longmapsto(fi,af)$$ is an equivalence, natural in the square data. The homotopy pullback records a path between the two composites, and the assertion includes all higher homotopies and empty retained-input sets. No categorical or operadic structure on the total family over $N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ alone is assumed.
